product.name: Monoprice 12-Outlet Surge Protector Power Strip - 3600 Joules 2 USB-C & 1 USB-A (30W PD) 6ft Cord
product.description: Monoprice™12‑Outlet Surge Protector Power Strip ‑ 3600 Joules, 2 USB‑C® + 1 USB‑A (30W PD), 6ft Power Cord, Flat Plug, WhiteThe Dependable Power Hub Built for the Way You Live and Work TodayPower up and protect your connected devices with the 12‑Outlet Surge Protector Power Strip‑the ultimate solution for modern homes, offices, and workstations that demand both performance and protection. Engineered with 3600 joules of surge protection, this high‑capacity power strip safeguards valuable electronics such as computers, televisions, gaming consoles, home theater systems, and office equipment from damaging power surges, spikes, and electrical noise.Designed for today's digital lifestyle, the 12‑Outlet Surge Protector Power Strip isn't just a power strip‑it's a comprehensive charging hub. With twelve AC outlets, two USB‑C ports, and one USB‑A port, you can charge multiple devices simultaneously without the clutter of extra adapters. The integrated USB‑C Power Delivery (PD) ports deliver up to 30W of fast charging‑ideal for smartphones, tablets, laptops, and other USB‑powered devices. Whether you're streaming, gaming, working, or relaxing, your devices stay powered and protected all day long.The surge protector features an electrical rating of 15A, 120V, 60Hz, and 1800W, providing dependable performance for even the most demanding environments. The EMI/RFI filtering (up to 40dB) ensures clean, stable power by minimizing electromagnetic and radio frequency interference‑perfect for maintaining clear audio, sharp video, and stable data transmission in connected systems.Built with safety and convenience in mind, this power strip includes a 2‑in‑1 Power & Circuit Breaker Switch that controls all outlets while offering overload protection. In the event of an electrical overload, the built‑in circuit breaker instantly cuts power to prevent equipment damage and ensure user safety. The LED protection indicator provides a clear, at‑a‑glance status of surge protection and grounding, so you always know your devices are safe.The 6‑foot SJT 3‑Prong 14AWG power cord provides flexibility in placement, allowing you to easily reach outlets across desks, entertainment centers, or workbenches. The 36‑degree flat plug design makes it easy to fit behind furniture and tight spaces without bending or damaging the cord‑ideal for modern living spaces and professional setups.Constructed from durable, heat‑resistant white plastic, the power strip complements any décor while providing long‑lasting reliability. Internally, advanced components maintain a clamping voltage of 500V (L‑N), 600V (L‑G), and 500V (N‑G), ensuring precise, responsive surge suppression that meets the highest safety standards.Whether you're setting up a smart home system, managing office technology, or organizing an entertainment center, the 12‑Outlet Surge Protector Power Strip delivers unmatched protection, power capacity, and convenience. Its combination of robust surge protection, fast USB charging, intelligent design, and safety certification makes it an essential tool for any environment that values both performance and peace of mind.High Surge Protection: Provides robust 3600 joules of surge protection to guard sensitive electronics against power spikes and voltage fluctuationsAll‑in‑One Power Hub: Features 12 AC outlets, 2 USB‑C ports, and 1 USB‑A port, offering versatile charging for computers, monitors, printers, smartphones, and tabletsFast USB Charging: Equipped with 30W Power Delivery (PD) via USB‑C for rapid charging of modern devices including laptops, tablets, and phonesSpace‑Saving Flat Plug: Designed with a 36‑degree flat plug that fits neatly behind furniture and tight spaces without bending the cordReliable Electrical Performance: Rated 15A, 120V, 60Hz, 1800W, ideal for high‑demand electronics and small appliancesAdvanced EMI/RFI Noise Filtering: Reduces interference up to 40dB, ensuring cleaner power delivery for improved device performance and signal clarity2‑in‑1 Power & Breaker Switch: Combines a master on/off control with an integrated circuit breaker for overload protection and added safetyLED Protection Indicator: Easy‑to‑see LED light shows power and surge protection status at a glancePrecision Surge Clamping: Clamping voltages of L‑N 500V, L‑G 600V, N‑G 500V provide rapid response and reliable suppression during electrical surges 3600 JOULES OF ADVANCED SURGE PROTECTIONEngineered with high‑capacity surge suppression, this power strip absorbs up to 3600 joules of excess energy from lightning strikes, power spikes, and voltage fluctuations. This robust protection shields your valuable electronics‑such as TVs, computers, routers, and audio systems‑from costly electrical damage. 12 AC OUTLETS FOR MAXIMUM CONNECTIVITYDesigned to power multiple devices simultaneously, this surge protector features twelve grounded AC outlets that accommodate a full workstation or entertainment setup. The well‑spaced layout allows bulky adapters and power bricks to plug in side by side without crowding. FAST‑CHARGING USB‑C & USB‑A PORTS (30W PD)Equipped with two USB‑C ports and one USB‑A port, this power strip delivers up to 30W Power Delivery (PD) for rapid charging of laptops, tablets, and smartphones. Enjoy fast, efficient power delivery without needing extra charging bricks, reducing clutter on your desk or entertainment area. DURABLE 6‑FOOT EXTRA LONG POWER CORDThe 6ft SJT 3‑Prong 14AWG power cord provides durability, flexibility, and dependable current flow. Its thick, insulated construction ensures long‑lasting performance, while the extended length gives you freedom to position the power strip exactly where you need it. SPACE‑SAVING 36° FLAT PLUG DESIGNFeaturing a low‑profile 36‑degree angled flat plug, this power strip fits easily behind furniture, cabinets, or entertainment centers. This clever design allows for a flush fit against walls, preventing cable strain and saving valuable space in tight setups. 2‑IN‑1 POWER & CIRCUIT BREAKER SWITCHThe built‑in power switch and resettable circuit breaker combine into one intuitive control, providing quick on/off functionality and reliable overload protection. In case of excessive load, the breaker trips to cut power‑protecting both your devices and the surge protector itself. LED PROTECTION & GROUND INDICATOR LIGHTSStay informed with bright LED status indicators that show at a glance whether your devices are properly protected and grounded. This visual feedback ensures you're always aware of the surge protector's operational status and protection readiness. EMI/RFI NOISE FILTERING FOR REDUCING INTERFERENCEFeaturing advanced EMI/RFI noise filtering up to 40dB, this surge protector minimizes electromagnetic and radio frequency interference. The result is cleaner, more stable power for sensitive electronics‑reducing static in audio systems, flicker in video displays, and data errors in connected equipment. PACKAGE CONTENTS• 1x Monoprice 12‑Outlet Surge Protector Power Strip ‑ 3600 Joules, 2 USB‑C + 1 USB‑A (30W PD), 6ft Power Cord, Flat Plug, White .gte-ctr .row{margin:0;}1 Year Replacement WarrantyMonoprice™ not only stands behind every product we sell with a 1 year replacement warranty, we offer a 30 day money back guarantee as well!
